name: metronome, just cleaner
description:
Take your metronome on stage.
Live Mode, Bluetooth pedals, and setlists. Your hands have better things to do.

See every beat.
A big beat number you can glance at. Clear accents. Your song, tempo, meter, and subdivision together.

Put your foot in charge.
Assign a compatible Bluetooth pedal to play/stop, next/previous song, tap tempo, or BPM up/down. Your assignments stay saved. Keyboard-style pedals control the app while it is on screen; media and MIDI modes have different capabilities.

Your set. In order.
Build setlists from your song library. Save tempo, meter, subdivision, sound, and notes for each song. Reorder by dragging. Change songs when you choose. Edit a shared song once; every setlist stays up to date.

Open. Play. No pop-ups.
Free for life. Ad-free for life. Every feature included.

Good sound. Good company.
Studio-grade recorded percussion, plus electronic clicks. Audition a sound and pick what sits well with your instrument. Ivory and graphite. Minimalism in every detail.

Practice with a little more purpose.
20–300 BPM. Dial, numeric entry, or tap tempo. Subdivisions, rests, swing, and custom rhythms. Shape the accents. Build speed with tempo ramps. Let silent bars test your internal pulse. Explore polyrhythms with two sounds of your choice.

For practice rooms, lessons, rehearsals, and stages. Piano, violin, guitar, drums. Your instrument belongs here.

All sounds and saved songs stay on your device. Basic playback works offline. A compatible pedal is optional and sold separately.
